svg.title: Do recent SPADL actions improve state probabilities?
svg.desc: Wyscout 2017/18 | whole-match calendar holdouts from 2018-03-01 | current goals excluded here Dots are paired mean loss differences; lines are 95% intervals from 1,000 whole-match bootstrap samples. Models are fixed before test evaluation. Intervals do not include training uncertainty or dependence between repeat teams. Post-action inputs and a ten-action window (including the current action); not the existing native pre-pass task.
